combo_label: In the Bathroom × Cheese × The Brontes

entries.clue: Vast northern county of dales and windswept tops, the writing family's home
Hung over slow-burning woodchips to take on a dark, bonfire note
Surname of the small plain Lowood girl, and the title word of her 1847 story
Layer count boasted on a pack of soft paper rolls
Trick-taking card game of Austen's day; now a very different room
Brooding master of Thornfield, blinded in the blaze that destroys his house
Welsh supper of savoury sauce browned on a thick slab of toast
Glass-walled box in the corner you step into and slide shut
Calf-stomach extract that makes warm milk set firm
Grid of glazed squares covering the splashback wall
Normandy round in a bloomy white jacket, best eaten oozing
Middle sister of the writing three, dead at thirty after a single fierce book
